Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:10:1.hebrew: הא הימוני מהימן - יחיד להיות גזבר:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:10:1.english: But he is trusted [to be appointed] on his own say-so - A single individual, to be a treasurer.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:10:2.english: Two brothers - With regard to the portion, they are considered as one.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:11:1.hebrew: מאי שררותיה - דקופה דקאמרת עלה לפי שאין עושין שררה על הצבור כו':
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:11:1.english: What is its authority? - Of the charity fund, about which you said [that two are needed to collect it] because one does not make [a position of] authority over the community, etc.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:11:2.hebrew: אפילו בע"ש - שיש פתחון פה לבעה"ב לומר: טרוד אני:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:11:2.english: Even on Friday - For the householder has an opening to say, "I am busy."

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:11:3.english: And I will punish, etc. - Evidently, it is forbidden to take a pledge [from people for charity].

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:13:1.hebrew: גבאי צדקה - המשכילים אל דל, מהו צריך:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:13:1.english: Charity collectors - [This refers to] "those who show insight toward the poor" [Psalms 41:2], [investigating] what he needs.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:14:1.hebrew: מלמדי תינוקות - מצדיקי רבים הן, שמלמדין ומחנכין אותן בדרך טובה:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:14:1.english: Teachers of children - They are "those who bring the many to righteousness," for they teach and educate them in a good way.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:14:2.hebrew: שבקתיה להמנותיך - שהיית רגיל ללמדם באמונה, וללמד ולישב על גבם תמיד:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:14:2.english: Have you abandoned your position of trust? - For you were accustomed to teach them faithfully, and to teach and sit over them constantly.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:14:3.english: My mind [is directed] there - To the children.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:15:1.hebrew: ורבנן מאי - תלמידי חכמים העוסקים בתורה תמיד, מאי כתיב בהו:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:15:1.english: And the Rabbis, what [is written about them]? - Torah scholars who constantly engage in Torah, what is written about them?

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:16:1.hebrew: לפרוש זה מזה - מפני החשד, שלא יאמרו: זה הגובה יחידי, דעתו לגנוב:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:16:1.english: To separate from one another - Because of suspicion, lest they say: This one who collects alone, his intention is to steal.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:16:2.hebrew: אבל זה פורש לחנות וזה לשער - זה לגבות מיושבי השער, וזה לגבות מיושבי החנות, ובלבד שיראו שניהן כאחד:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:16:2.english: But this one may separate to the shop and that one to the gate - This one to collect from those who sit at the gate, and that one to collect from those who sit in the shop, provided that the two of them are seen [together] as one.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:16:3.hebrew: לא יתנם לתוך כיסו - שלא יאמרו: מעות של צדקה הוא גונב:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:16:3.english: He may not put them into his pocket - So that [people] will not say, "He is stealing charity money."

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:17:1.hebrew: פורטין - פרוטות שגבו, לוקחין דינרי כסף, לפי שהפרוטות של נחושת מחלידות:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:17:1.english: They exchange for small change - The perutot that they collected, they take [in exchange for them] silver dinars, because copper perutot rust.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:17:2.hebrew: ואין פורטין לעצמם - פן יחשדום שפורטין בזול:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:17:2.english: And they may not change [money] for themselves - Lest people suspect them of changing [the coins] at a discount.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:17:3.hebrew: אין מונין אותם שנים שנים - פן יאמרו: שנים הוא נוטל, ואינו מונה אלא אחד:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:17:3.english: They do not count them two by two - Lest they say: He is taking two, and counting only one.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:18:1.hebrew: אציפי דבי כנישתא - מחצלות של בית הכנסת, משום דמזבני להו ממעות הקופה:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:18:1.english: The mats of the synagogue - The mats of the synagogue, because they are purchased from the money of the charity fund.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:4:1.hebrew: שבי כולהו איתנהו ביה - שהוא ביד העכומ"ז לעשות בו כל חפצו, אם למות, [אם לחרב,] אם לרעב:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:4:1.english: Captivity has all of them in it - For [the captive] is in the hand of the idolater, [who is able] to do with him whatever he wishes: whether to death, [whether to the sword,] or to famine.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:5:1.hebrew: מפני שהוא כדיני ממונות - לעיין ולתת לכל אחד כפי טפלים התלויין בו:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:5:1.english: Because it is like monetary law - To examine [the matter] and to give each one according to the dependents who rely on him.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:6:1.hebrew: שגבויה וחלוקה שוה - בכל יום, מדי יום ביום, כדקתני לקמיה. לפיכך אין גבויו בשנים, שלא יצטרכו לטרוח ולבקש את השלישי לחלק:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:6:1.english: For its collection and its distribution are equal - Every day, each and every day, as it teaches below. Therefore its collection is not done by two [people], so that they will not need to go to the trouble of seeking out the third [person] to distribute it.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:7:1.hebrew: לעשות קופה תמחוי - לחלק לעניי עולם, אם ירבו עליהן:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:7:1.english: To make the charity fund (kuppah) a soup kitchen (tamchui) - To distribute [its funds] to the poor of the world [i.e., transient poor], if they become numerous upon them.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:8:1.hebrew: להתנות על המדות - להגדיל סאת העיר או להקטין:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:8:1.english: To stipulate regarding the measures - To enlarge the city's se'ah [measure] or to reduce [it].

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:8:2.hebrew: ועל השערים - שער חטין והיין, שלא ימכרנה שנה זו יותר מכך וכך דמים:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:8:2.english: And on the prices - The price of wheat and wine, that one may not sell it this year for more than such-and-such an amount of money.

Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:8:3.hebrew: להסיע על קיצתם - לקנוס את העובר על קיצת דבריהם, להסיעם מדת דין תורה:
Rashi on Bava Batra 8b:8:3.english: To penalize [people] for [violating] their fixed ruling - To fine the one who transgresses their fixed ruling, to remove them from the standard of Torah law.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 8b:12:1.hebrew: כי הא דרבא אכפיה - אחר היה עמו, דאין עושין שררה על הצבור פחות מב', ולא חשיב ליה מפני כבודו של רבא:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 8b:12:1.english: Like this case of Rava, who compelled [Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak] - Another person was with him, since one may not exercise authority over the community with fewer than two [people]; but [the Gemara] does not count him, out of respect for Rava.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 8b:12:2.english: He coerced Rav Natan - And if you ask: But in the chapter Kol HaBasar (Chullin 110b, and there, s.v. Kol) it says: Any positive commandment whose reward is [written] alongside it, the earthly court is not warned about it. And regarding charity it is written, "you shall surely open your hand to him," and it is written, "for because of this thing the Lord your God will bless you" (Deuteronomy 15:10). And Rabbeinu Tam said that this coercion is [only] with words, like "kefiyah ve'al" in the chapter Na'arah SheNitpateta (Ketubot 53a). And he further answered that here they [the townspeople] accepted upon themselves that the collectors would coerce them. And it appears to Rabbi Yitzchak that with charity we do coerce, because it contains a negative commandment, as it is written regarding it, "you shall not harden your heart and you shall not shut your hand, etc." And it appears to the Ritzva that the rule that a court is not warned about positive commandments whose reward is alongside them means that they are not punished; and so it implies in the Yerushalmi, in [the chapter] HaMokher et HaSefinah. And that case in Kol HaBasar (ibid.), where [the son] did not honor his father and they bound him, and [the father] said to them, "Leave him," the meaning is: you are not enjoined to compel him [by force] until he performs it, as is done with other positive commandments, for if one says to him, "Make a sukkah" or "[take] a lulav," and he does not do so, we strike him until his soul departs, as stated in [the chapter] HaKotev (Ketubot 86b, and there). [And see also Tosafot Ketubot 49b, s.v. Akhfeih, and Tosafot Chullin 110b, s.v. Kol.]

Tosafot on Bava Batra 8b:13:1.hebrew: דין אמת לאמתו - "אמת" לאפוקי דין מרומה, אע"ג שהעדים מעידין אותו [אין מחתכים אותו], כיון שיודעים שמשקרים. כדדרשינן (בסנהדרין דף ז.) [צ"ל בשבועות ל:]: "לאמתו" — שלא יטו את הדין [וע"ע תוס' מגילה טו: ד"ה זה]:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 8b:13:1.english: "A true judgment, to its truth" - "True" excludes a fraudulent judgment: even though witnesses testify to it [we do not finalize it], since [the judges] know that they are lying. As we expound (in Sanhedrin 7a) [it should read: in Shevuot 30b]: "To its truth" — that they should not pervert the judgment. [And see also Tosafot on Megillah 15b, s.v. "zeh."]

Tosafot on Bava Batra 8b:14:1.hebrew: ומצדיקי הרבים וגו' אלו מלמדי תינוקות - אומר ר"י דצריך לומר דרקיע מזהיר טפי מכוכבים, דהא בס"פ אלו עוברין (פסחים מט: ושם ד"ה לא) משמע דגבאי צדקה עדיפי ממלמדי תינוקות, דאמר: לא מצא בת תלמיד חכם, ישא בת גבאי צדקה; לא מצא בת גבאי צדקה, ישא בת מלמדי תינוקות. ואריב"א כי מצא בפרקי דרבי אליעזר דרקיע דהאי קרא דהמשכילים יזהירו כזוהר הרקיע, היינו רקיע שעל ראשי החיות, שמזהירין מכוכבים, שאורו כאור החמה. והאי דקאמר ורבנן מאי, אמר רבינא ואוהביו כצאת השמש — היינו שמש של עתיד לבא, דהוא שבעתים כאור שבעת הימים; ואור שבעת ימי בראשית היה שבעתים מאור חמה של עכשיו, כדמפרש תרגום של רני ושמחי (זכריה ב):
Tosafot on Bava Batra 8b:14:1.english: "And those who bring the many to righteousness," etc. – these are teachers of children - Rabbi Yitzchak says that one must say that the firmament shines more than the stars, for at the end of the chapter "Elu Overin" (Pesachim 49b, and see the entry beginning "Lo") it implies that charity collectors are preferable to teachers of children, as it says: If one did not find the daughter of a Torah scholar, let him marry the daughter of a charity collector; if he did not find the daughter of a charity collector, let him marry the daughter of a teacher of children. And the Riva said that he found in Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer that the firmament of this verse, "And those who are wise shall shine like the brightness of the firmament," is the firmament that is above the heads of the *chayot* (the celestial beings), which shines more than the stars, since its light is like the light of the sun. And as for what [the Gemara] says, "And what of the Rabbis?" – Ravina said: "And those who love Him are like the sun going forth in its might" – this refers to the sun of the future to come, which is sevenfold, like the light of the seven days; and the light of the seven days of creation was sevenfold that of the sun of the present, as the Targum explains [the verse] "Sing and rejoice" (Zechariah 2).

Tosafot on Bava Batra 8b:1:1.hebrew: פדיון שבוים מצוה רבה - והא דאמר בפרק בני העיר (מגילה דף כז.): אין מוכרין ס"ת אלא ללמוד תורה ולישא אשה, ולא קתני פדיון שבוים — שמא מילתא דפשיטא היא, ולא איצטריך למיתני:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 8b:1:1.english: Redeeming captives is a great mitzvah - And as for what [the Gemara] says in the chapter "Bnei HaIr" (Megillah 27a): "One may not sell a Torah scroll except in order to study Torah or to marry a woman," and it does not teach [that one may sell it for] redeeming captives — perhaps it is because it is a self-evident matter, and it was not necessary to teach it.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 8b:5:1.hebrew: ומתחלקת בג' מפני שהיא כדיני ממונות - וא"ת: מהאי טעמא נמי תהא נגבית בג'? ופר"ת: לפי שהיה ידוע סכום של כל אחד ואחד, כמה יתן:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 8b:5:1.english: "And it is distributed by three, because it is like cases of monetary law" - And if you ask: for this reason, it should also be collected by three? And Rabbeinu Tam explains: because the amount of each and every person was known — how much he would give.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 8b:7:1.hebrew: ולשנות' לכל מה שירצו - נראה לר"ת דיכולים לשנותו אף לדבר הרשות. אע"ג דאמרינן בערכין בפ"ק (דף ו: ושם): האי מאן דנדב שרגא לבי כנשתא — אסור לשנותה לדבר הרשות. ואמר נמי התם: האומר "פרוטה זו לצדקה" עד שלא באה ליד הגבאי — מותר לשנותה; משבאה ליד הגבאי — אסור לשנותה לדבר הרשות. הכא שבני העיר משנים אותה שאני; לפיכך מותר לשנותה אפילו לדבר הרשות, ואפילו באה ליד הגבאי. וכן היה ר"ת נוהג לתת מעות הקופה לשומרי העיר, לפי שעל דעת בני העיר נותנים אותם:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 8b:7:1.english: "And to change it for whatever they wish" - It appears to Rabbeinu Tam that they may change it even for a voluntary (non-mitzvah) purpose, even though we say in Arakhin, chapter 1 (6b and there): One who donated a lamp to a synagogue is forbidden to change it for a voluntary purpose. And it also says there: One who says, "This coin is for charity," before it has reached the hand of the collector, it is permitted to change it; once it has reached the hand of the collector, it is forbidden to change it for a voluntary purpose. Here, where the townspeople themselves are changing it, it is different; therefore it is permitted to change it even for a voluntary purpose, and even if it has reached the hand of the collector. And so Rabbeinu Tam would practice: to give the money of the charity fund to the town's guards, because they give it with the consent of the townspeople.
